title: RW-Flow: One-Step Generation on Compact Manifolds via Wasserstein Gradient Flows
abstract: arXiv:2609.39271v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Manifold-valued data, and consequently the distributions they induce, are prevalent across many domains, ranging from the locations of geospatial events, such as earthquakes, to biomolecular torsion angles that encode information about three-dimensional structure. While diffusion and flow-based generative models have been successfully extended to compact manifolds, sampling typically requires tens or hundreds of sequential network evaluations. We introduce RW-Flow, a theoretically grounded framework for learning one-step generative models on compact manifolds via Wasserstein gradient flows. The main challenge is identifiability: driving the velocity field to zero should guarantee that the model distribution matches the target distribution. We establish a necessary and sufficient condition for identifiability on compact, connected Riemannian manifolds. translated_title: RW-Flow：基于Wasserstein梯度流在紧致流形上实现一步生成
translated_abstract: 流形取值的数据及其所诱导的分布在众多领域中普遍存在，从地震等地理空间事件的位置，到编码三维结构信息的生物分子扭转角。尽管扩散模型和基于流的生成模型已被成功扩展至紧致流形，但其采样通常需要数十甚至数百次顺序网络评估。我们提出RW-Flow，这是一个理论扎实的框架，通过Wasserstein梯度流在紧致流形上学习一步生成模型。其主要挑战在于可识别性：将速度场驱动至零时，应能保证模型分布与目标分布相匹配。我们在紧致连通黎曼流形上建立了可识别性的充要条件，并特别证明了：对于对称且满足Lipschitz连续性的代价函数，速度场……
tldr: 提出RW-Flow框架，通过Wasserstein梯度流在紧致流形上实现一步生成模型，并建立了流形上可识别性的充要条件，从而免去扩散模型所需的大量顺序网络评估。
en_tdlr: RW-Flow is a theoretically grounded framework that learns one-step generative models on compact manifolds via Wasserstein gradient flows, establishing a necessary and sufficient condition for identifiability.
